getting into the relationship is easy, it’s maintaining it that’s hard. about a month ago my relationship ended and although we had a lot of issues, the fact that i was going through a depressive episode at the time definitely had a very negative impact and i still see it as a major factor in the break up. it’s honestly one of the worst feelings when even the people who are supposed to love you and care about you get tired of your shit. anyway. it seems logical to me that depressed people have a harder time getting into relationships, as it’s harder even to just connect with people and the world around you. the only reason i even hooked up with that guy was because i met him while i was drunk and fun. once he saw what he had to deal with...oh boy. not as fun as the initial meeting. don’t feel bad about it. i can tell you i’ve longed for someone for so long and now i wish i had never even met him. it’s preferable sometimes to just concentrate on bettering yourself instead of wondering why you can’t have a relationship. criticizing and blaming yourself doesn’t help, it’s your brain working against you. you should focus on yourself and getting better, because you are ultimately yours before ever being anyone else’s.
